title: S2 frozen manifest model controls exceeded verifier contract
symptom: create built the candidate but fail-closed verification rejected the S2 fixture model controls
reproduction: create an S2 candidate from source commit 9108d0c and verify the generated freeze bundle

evidence.detail: verify_routing_s1_live_freeze raised S1 live freeze fixture model controls differ before any model turn

root_cause: The new S2 fixture manifest duplicated runtime controls under model, while the inherited frozen fixture contract allows exactly allowed and auth_method; the live environment fingerprint already seals the other controls.

considered_options.option: relax verifier to accept arbitrary model keys
considered_options.reason: weakens the unchanged S1 frozen-manifest trust boundary

considered_options.option: keep runtime controls in the Plan environment and restore the exact two-key fixture model contract
considered_options.reason: preserves S1 compatibility and removes duplication

resolution: Removed reasoning_effort, SDK, approval_mode, and sandbox from the S2 fixture model block and added a frozen-manifest contract regression.
remaining_risks: The failed zero-turn revision 1 artifact and state are preserved outside the repository and are not execution candidates.
